notes.title: Psydra Games Shutting Down
notes.notes: It is with heavy hearts that we announce the closure of Psydra Games. As part of the closure process, we are transferring ownership of our game, Dark Scavenger, to a new owner. We would like to thank our team, and all our fans for their support over the years.

notes.title: Mike Dies is now available on Steam! Explore a huge space station! Collect all the things! Get sliced in half!
notes.notes:
After 5 years of development, we have finally released Mike Dies on Steam! 

It's a challenging new take on the Metroidvania genre, with a twisted sci-fi narrative and brutal dynamic death scenes. 

The game was inspired by titles like Super Meat Boy, VVVVVV and Super Metroid. The Dev Team actually calls the game a Super Meatroidvania. 

Please check it out!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/696200/Mike_Dies/

notes.title: The Dark Scavenger Original Soundtrack is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Dark Scavenger's soundtrack has finally made its way onto Steam!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/UHLQFxk.png[/img]

The soundtrack includes 16 songs including an exclusive bonus medley. You can find out more about it here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/339770 

You can also listen to it on Bandcamp: https://psydragames.bandcamp.com/album/dark-scavenger-ost

As always, thanks for the support!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Steam Overlay, and Future Updates
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We just pushed an update to fix a bunch of bugs reported to us since the Steam release. This includes getting the Steam overlay working so you should be able to take screenshots now.

I'm also going to take the opportunity to fill you guys in on what we are currently working on.

[b]Demo:[/b]
The new demo will include the prologue and chapter 1. Also, save files will transfer to the full version of the game, meaning people who play the demo and buy the full version afterward will have the option to pick up where they left off.

[b] Linux: [/b]
After the demo is finished, we will be working on getting Dark Scavenger working on Linux. This shouldn't be too difficult, because the game uses Adobe Air. For those of you who don't want to use Adobe Air, we are looking at porting the game into a different coding language. I can't say for sure when or if this will happen since we're neck deep in our next project.

That's it for now. Thanks again for the support!

notes.title: Help us out by applying tags to our Store Page!
notes.notes:
As you've probably noticed, the community's choice games during the Summer Sale appear to have been picked using tags. It seems unlikely that this will change for future sales, so if you want to help us out, please consider applying tags to Dark Scavenger.

Here's a link to Steam's most popular tags: http://store.steampowered.com/tag/browse/#global_19

Let us know if you have any tags for Dark Scavenger that don't show up in popular tags.

Thanks everyone!
